note: Keys are 5-digit ZIPs. A value is "<STATE><DISTRICT>" (district 0 = at-large or a territorial delegate). Where a ZIP spans more than one district the value is an array of all of them — ask the user which is theirs rather than guessing. "zip3" maps a 3-digit prefix to its state(s), for ZIPs with no ZCTA (PO-box and single-organisation ZIPs); it answers the governor, senator and capital questions but not the representative.
